calls.function: claim(address[] users, address[] tokens, uint256[] amounts, bytes32[][] proofs)

items.free: the cumulative amount in the Merkle leaf: the distributor reverts unless the proof hashes it into the published root; the effects require the Safe to get a positive amount of the card's token and nothing else

free.proof: a Merkle proof: the distributor reverts unless it proves the leaf (user, token, amount) against the root

calls.merge: the Merkl app claims several reward tokens in one call, one item per token in each of the four arrays
